comparison_coverage: Grahn PRC 80 PDF 2 and 4 confirm identical 182Hg RDDS. Bree PRL 112 Table I reviewed. Wrzosek-Lipska EPJA 55 PDF 2–4 and 11–13 provide 2007/2008 run table, revised input and updated reported matrix elements.

normalized_yield_arithmetic.basis: Thesis Table 4.1, PDF 107, Ring 1, 351-keV deexcitation and 1000 um distance. No DDCM refit.

remaining: Beam rates differ between the thesis and 2019 run descriptions. The shared 2008 Cd conditions establish overlap at campaign/setting level; complete event identity is unverified.

The plotted no-lifetime checks hold other fitted matrix elements fixed. The 2019 analysis updates conversion inputs, includes correlation and omits 182,184Hg diagonal values; do not count older diagonal signs as independent support.

The thesis DDCM derivative has a printed dimensional conflict and the 186Hg shape wording conflicts with its sign and conclusion. The original analysis code, fit cards and fine-grained model covariance were not reproduced.
